parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
State $\frac{dy}{d\theta}=1-2\sin\theta$ — B1. Guidance: ignore the left side throughout if $dx/dt$, $dy/dt$, $dx$ or $dy$ is used, but $\frac{dy}{dx}$ must be seen for the final A1.

Use the correct quotient rule, or product rule after rewriting $x$ as $\cos\theta(2-\sin\theta)^{-1}$ — M1. Guidance: an incorrect formula seen gives M0 A0; otherwise benefit of doubt.

Obtain $\frac{dx}{d\theta}=\frac{-2\sin\theta+\sin^2\theta-\cos^2\theta}{(2-\sin\theta)^2}$ or equivalent — A1. Guidance: $-\sin\theta(2-\sin\theta)^{-1}-\cos\theta(2-\sin\theta)^{-2}(-\cos\theta)$ or equivalent.

Use $\frac{dy}{dx}=\frac{dy}{d\theta}\div\frac{dx}{d\theta}$ — M1. Guidance: allow even if there are errors in both derivatives.

Obtain $\frac{dy}{dx}=(2-\sin\theta)^2$ — A1. Guidance: AG; working above is required. Allow $\cos^2\theta+\sin^2\theta=1$ to be implied. If $x$ replaces $\theta$, or $\theta$ is missing more than twice on the right side, final A0.

Total: 5
